answer: Random-beacon spot checks with compute heartbeats block bulk fake identities. A beacon picks agents at random; each must answer in 10 minutes, proving a live kernel of work. A jade badge follows three passes and fades after silence. Idle identities cannot rest on velvet. Forging 1000 identities costs 1000 x 12 units, 12000 total, against under 8 earned each, so fraud loses money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
